name: XPR-3DGS
definition: A point-based differentiable rendering method using 3D Gaussians, implementing project, evaluate, and tile_cull functions within the XPR framework.
summary: XPR-3DGS is a Python-based 3D Gaussian Splatting implementation that sets itself apart by requiring significantly fewer lines of code than traditional C++ or CUDA versions while maintaining comparable visual fidelity.
